entities.summary: Taewon An clan was one of the known Korean clans in history. Their Bon-gwan was in Shanxi, China. According to a research in 2000, Taewon An clan was founded in 1396 by a man named An Man se. He was from Taiyuan and served as a bureaucrat in the Yuan dynasty. He entered Goryeo as a fatherly master of Princess Noguk, an Imperial princess who married a commoner. Later, he served as Minister of Rites and began the Taewon An clan. Taiyuan was his hometown.
